## The 5 Core Verbs

```r
library(tidyverse)
```

### 1. filter() - Select Rows

```r
# Single condition
data |> filter(age > 30)

# Multiple conditions (AND)
data |> filter(age > 30, sex == "F")

# OR condition
data |> filter(age > 30 | treatment == "Drug")

# Values in a list
data |> filter(group %in% c("A", "B", "C"))

# NOT
data |> filter(status != "excluded")
```

### 2. select() - Select Columns

```r
# By name
data |> select(id, age, outcome)

# Range
data |> select(id:outcome)

# Exclude
data |> select(-notes, -date_entered)

# Helpers
data |> select(starts_with("lab_"))
data |> select(ends_with("_score"))
data |> select(contains("visit"))
data |> select(where(is.numeric))
```

### 3. mutate() - Create/Modify Columns

```r
# New column
data |> mutate(bmi = weight / height^2)

# Conditional
data |> mutate(
  category = case_when(
    score < 50 ~ "Low",
    score < 75 ~ "Medium",
    TRUE ~ "High"
  )
)

# Multiple columns
data |> mutate(
  z_score = (value - mean(value)) / sd(value),
  log_value = log10(value)
)
```

### 4. arrange() - Sort Rows

```r
# Ascending
data |> arrange(age)

# Descending
data |> arrange(desc(age))

# Multiple columns
data |> arrange(group, desc(score))
```

### 5. summarize() - Aggregate

```r
# Basic summary
data |> summarize(
  mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_val = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
  n = n()
)

# By group
data |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(outcome),
    se = sd(outcome) / sqrt(n())
  )
```

## Useful Functions Inside Verbs

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `n()` | Count rows |
| `n_distinct()` | Count unique values |
| `first()` | First value |
| `last()` | Last value |
| `mean()` | Mean |
| `median()` | Median |
| `sd()` | Standard deviation |
| `min()` / `max()` | Min/max |
| `sum()` | Sum |
| `is.na()` | Test for NA |
| `!is.na()` | Test for NOT NA |

## Common Patterns

### Count by Group
```r
data |> count(group)
data |> count(group, sort = TRUE)
```

### Rename Columns
```r
data |> rename(new_name = old_name)
```

### Remove Duplicates
```r
data |> distinct()
data |> distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

### Drop Missing
```r
data |> drop_na()
data |> drop_na(outcome)
```

### Add Row Numbers
```r
data |> mutate(row_id = row_number())
```

## Joining Data

```r
# Left join (keep all from x)
left_join(x, y, by = "id")

# Inner join (keep only matches)
inner_join(x, y, by = "id")

# Full join (keep all)
full_join(x, y, by = "id")

# Different column names
left_join(x, y, by = c("patient_id" = "id"))
```

## The Pipe Operator

```r
# Read left to right: "then"
data |>
  filter(age >= 18) |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  summarize(mean_outcome = mean(outcome)) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_outcome))
```
